name: Can I switch to a flexible commission after starting with a traditional listing?

mainEntity.name: Can I switch to a flexible commission after starting with a traditional listing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can switch to a flexible commission after initially starting with a traditional listing depends on the terms of your signed listing agreement with your agent. Typically, these agreements are legally binding for a set period. You would need to discuss any modifications with your agent and potentially amend or terminate the existing contract. Understanding your current agreement’s clauses regarding termination or modification is a crucial preparation step before considering any changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Switching to a flexible commission after a traditional listing depends on your existing listing agreement's terms, requiring discussion with your agent and potential contract amendment.
